name: 75407 · Princeton, TX
findings: ZIP 75407 (Princeton) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75407 (Princeton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 75407 (Princeton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.
